title: Covered in Ash
wikitext:
{{status | name = Covered In Ash | type = Debuff | icon = Ash status icon.png | description = You are slowed and you take Increased Fire Damage. | bonuses = {{c|mod|20% less Movement Speed}}
{{c|mod|20% increased Fire Damage Taken}} }} '''Covered In Ash''' is a [[debuff]] that causes the affected target to have less [[movement speed]] and increased [[fire]] [[damage taken]]. Covered in Ash has a default duration of 4 seconds. The default magnitude of less Movement Speed is 20% and the increased fire damage taken is 20%. ==Skill gems== {{Query stat related skill gems |type=active |where = skill.description LIKE "%Cover%Ash%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%Cover%Ash%" |stat_page=Covered in Ash }} {{Query stat related skill gems |type=support |where = skill.description LIKE "%Cover%Ash%" OR skill.stat_text LIKE "%Cover%Ash%" OR skill.skill_id LIKE "%Pyre%" |stat_page=Covered in Ash }} ==Unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |where=BINARY items.stat_text LIKE "%Ash%" AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Herald%of%Ash%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Related modifiers== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%Cover%ash%" AND domain NOT IN ("35", "38") |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |domain=1 }} vendor recipe only mod: * {{ml|BreachBodyCoverInAshWhenHit1__|display=verbose}} (see {{il|Grasping Mail}}'s article for details) Legacy mods: * {{ml|VillageCoverInAshOnHit|display=stat_text}} (Weapons enchanted during [[Settlers league]] ([[Runesmithing]]) and transferred to Standard HC and SC leagues) ==Passives== {{Query passive skills |where= passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%ash%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%splash%" AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT LIKE "%herald_of_ash%" }} ==Monsters== The following [[monster]]s use "[[Skill:CoverInAsh|Cover In Ash]]" skills: {{#cargo_query: |tables=monsters |fields=name=Monster names, CONCAT("[[", _pageName, "|", metadata_id, "]]")=internal ids, skill_ids |where=skill_ids HOLDS LIKE "CoverInAsh" and name != "Xoph's Loyal" |limit=100 |order by=name }} In additions, [[Xoph's Loyal]] also inflict this debuff. However, since original Breach monsters are replaced by new monsters that introduced during [[Keepers league]]s, this monster can only be found as a [[Raise Spectre|spectre]] raised before removal. ==Version history== In the past, {{psl|Hinekora, Death's Fury}} also granted the player to inflict this debuff. It is still retained in {{psl|id=AscendancyAscendant33_}} passive skill for [[Ascendant]]. {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|2.5.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==See also== * [[Covered in Frost]] ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Bex_GGG|date=November 20, 2016|title=Recently Asked Community Questions|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1770220|publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums|accessdate=November 21, 2016}} Based on the reminder text of {{il|Xoph's Blood}}, {{il|Earendel's Embrace}} and {{il|Infernal Cry}} when pressing Alt button in PC }} [[Category:Debuffs]]
